good_for: It's a free desktop app that runs AI models right on your computer, so what you type stays private unless you choose its optional paid cloud models.
name: LM Studio
watch_out: You need a fairly strong computer: 16GB of memory is recommended, and 8GB works only with smaller models.

name: Poe
good_for: Great for trying many different AI models in one app - GPT, Claude, Llama, and more - and comparing their answers side by side.
watch_out: The free plan limits how much you can chat each day; the paid plan costs $4.99 a month.

name: Windsurf
good_for: An AI code editor that understands your whole project and can change many files at once, with you watching each step.
watch_out: The free plan only gives you a light quota for AI agents; the Pro plan costs $20 a month. Windsurf is now called Devin Desktop.

name: Lovable
good_for: Great for non-programmers: describe the app or website you want in plain words and it builds a working version for you.
watch_out: The free plan gives you 5 build credits a day (up to 30 a month), and bigger tasks cost more credits; the Pro plan costs $25 a month, or $21 a month if you pay for a year.

name: Otter.ai
good_for: Joins your meetings and writes down what everyone says, so you get notes and summaries without typing a word.
watch_out: The free plan gives you 300 transcription minutes a month and only 3 file imports in total; the Pro plan costs $16.99 a month, or $8.33 a month if you pay for a year.

name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)
good_for: Great for studying: upload your documents and ask it questions, or turn them into a podcast-style audio chat between two AI hosts.
watch_out: It only answers from the documents you upload, so weak sources mean weak answers.

name: Photoshop (generative fill)
good_for: Inside Photoshop, add or remove anything in a photo with a text prompt - the AI fills in the rest to match.
watch_out: You need a paid plan: Photoshop costs $22.99 a month (annual plan, billed monthly) and comes with generative credits for AI features. Creative Cloud Pro, which bundles more apps and AI tools, costs $69.99 a month at its regular price.

name: Perplexity Comet
good_for: A web browser with an AI assistant built in that can summarize pages, compare products, and do small tasks for you.
watch_out: The free version of Comet does not include the browser agent that does tasks for you; that needs a paid Perplexity plan.

good_for: Type a description and it creates images for you, with lots of ready-made style templates to start from.
name: Playground AI
watch_out: The free plan is limited to 5 images every 3 hours and 6 credits a month, and runs slower at busy times, and the premium models use monthly credits.

good_for: An AI teammate that handles your email, calendar, meetings, and routine office work when you tell it what to do.
name: Lindy
watch_out: The $50 of free credits lasts only 7 days, then paid use starts at $29.99 per user per month. Credits do not roll over, and bigger jobs use more of them.

good_for: Talking through ideas or worries with a friendly, conversational AI.
name: Pi by Inflection
watch_out: Pi can make mistakes, so double-check important facts, and your chats are only saved past 60 days if you log in.

good_for: Listening to articles, documents, and books read aloud in natural-sounding voices.
name: Speechify
watch_out: The free plan's voices sound robotic, and the natural-voice Premium plan costs $29/month.

good_for: Turn a long video or podcast into short vertical clips with captions for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.
name: Opus Clip
watch_out: Plans run on credits: the free plan gives 60 a month, adds a watermark, and its clips can only be exported for 3 days. The $15 Starter plan gives 150 credits a month and is monthly only.

good_for: Turn a blog post, script, or long recording into a captioned video with stock footage matched to your words.
name: Pictory
watch_out: There is no ongoing free plan, only a 14-day trial that exports at 720p, and paying month to month costs $29 instead of $25.

good_for: Type a script and get a video of a lifelike AI presenter saying it, in over 140 languages.
name: Synthesia
watch_out: The Starter plan adds only about 12 minutes of video a month on top of the free 10, and free videos carry a Synthesia watermark, so steady publishing means a bigger plan.

good_for: Generate royalty-free background music from a text prompt for videos, podcasts, and apps.
name: Mubert
watch_out: The free plan adds an audible watermark and requires attribution, and tracks can't be released on Spotify or registered with Content ID.

good_for: Check whether scientific papers are supported or contradicted by later research, with AI-written summaries.
name: Scite
watch_out: There is no ongoing free plan, only a 7-day free trial that turns into a paid subscription unless you cancel.

good_for: Build an AI voice assistant that answers and makes real phone calls for your business.
name: Vapi
watch_out: The $0.05 a minute covers only Vapi's own fee. The AI model, voice, transcriber, and phone line cost extra, so the page's 1,000-minute example adds up to $82 to $129 a month.

good_for: Build chatbots and conversational forms for your website by dragging and dropping blocks, no coding needed.
name: Typebot
watch_out: Chat limits count every new conversation, so a busy site can burn through the free 200 chats a month quickly.
